start.title: Component Builder
start.desc: Build a Components-V2 message from scratch, import JSON, or continue from a saved message.

builder.title: Component Builder
builder.desc: The message below this one is your design. Pick a component to edit it, or press Add… to put a new one inside it, after it, or at the end. Buttons and selects are live previews with Custom IDs starting with `c-`. Press Call a system… on a button to make it open a ticket, buy a reward and more.
builder.placeholder: Your message will appear here - press Add… to get started.
builder.waitingForText: Waiting for your next message to set the selected text - emojis and mentions included.
builder.needsComponent: Add at least one component before saving or sending.
builder.manageRequired: Saving, sending, and editing messages requires the Manage Server permission.
builder.notYourBuilder: This builder belongs to someone else.

bind.system: Which system should this button call?
bind.empty: There is nothing to pick here yet. Set it up in that system's settings first.

buttonActions.switch: Switch this panel to a saved design

modals.contentHint: Markdown, mentions, and emojis are supported
modals.colorHint: Hex like #5865F2 - leave empty for no color bar
modals.galleryHint: image URL | alt text (alt text optional, up to 10 lines)
modals.customIdHint: Starts with c- or comes from Call a system…, unique in this message
modals.optionsHint: Label | value | description (value and description optional, up to 25 lines)

save.title: Save message
save.nameHint: Saving under an existing name overwrites it

send.webhookPlaceholder: Send via webhook to up to 5 channels
send.optionalHint: Optional - leave empty to use my own identity
send.webhookUrlHint: Optional - send straight to this webhook instead of creating one

edit.title: Edit an existing message
edit.linkHint: I can edit my own messages and my webhooks' messages

io.jsonHint: A components array, a single component, a full message, or a share link
io.guide:
**Importing from another builder**
Design your message on [discord.builders](https://discord.builders/), [Discohook](https://discohook.app) or [message.style](https://message.style/app/editor/new), then paste its **share link** or its JSON below.
-# JSON too long for one field? Continue in the next one. The fields are joined in order.
io.embedsDetected: That JSON is an embed message. Import it with the embed builder: {{command}}
io.linkFailed: Couldn't read that link. Share links expire after a while (message.style after 7 days), so copy the message's JSON and paste that instead.
io.droppedFiles: {{count}} uploaded file(s) or image(s) were left out, because the builder can only use links.

settings.overviewDescription: Reusable Components-V2 messages - built with the component builder.

descriptions.name: The name this message is saved and referenced under
descriptions.openBuilder: Edit this message's components in a builder thread

errors.tooManyComponents: This message is full - remove a component first.
errors.tooLargeToOpen: This design has {{count}} components, but the builder holds at most {{limit}}. Export it with {{command}}, remove some components, then import it again.
errors.legacyBuilder: This builder was opened before an update and can no longer be edited. Open a new one with {{command}}.
errors.designMissing: The design message of this builder is gone. Open a new builder with {{command}}.
errors.designEditFailed: The design could not be updated: {{error}}
errors.rowFull: A row holds up to 5 buttons, or exactly one select menu.
errors.sectionFull: A section holds up to 3 text components.
errors.sectionNeedsText: A section needs at least one text component.
errors.selectOptionCount: A select menu holds 1 to 25 choices.
errors.customIdPrefix: Custom IDs must start with `c-` or come from Call a system…, and be at most 100 characters long.
errors.customIdTaken: That value is already used in this message - pick a unique one.
errors.minOverMax: Minimum can't exceed maximum, and maximum can't exceed the number of choices.
errors.tooLong: That text is longer than Discord allows here.
errors.tooMuchText: This message is out of text space - Discord allows 4000 characters across all text components, and the builder reserves some for itself.
errors.unsupportedComponent: That component type isn't supported by this builder.
errors.invalidJson: That JSON couldn't be parsed into Components-V2 components.
errors.noThread: I couldn't create a builder thread here - use this in a regular text channel.
errors.designGone: That saved design no longer exists.
errors.previewSwitch: Switching is off in the builder preview, because it would replace your unsaved design. Send the message, then use the button there.
errors.noWebhook: I couldn't create or access a webhook in {{channel}}.
errors.invalidWebhookUrl: That doesn't look like a Discord webhook URL.
errors.webhookWrongGuild: That webhook belongs to a different server.
errors.webhookUnreachable: I couldn't reach that webhook - check the URL is still valid.
errors.webhookNoComponents: That webhook can't carry buttons or selects - only webhooks I own can. Remove the interactive components or send without a webhook URL.
errors.webhookIdentityTooLong: That webhook name and avatar URL are too long to carry - use a shorter one or send via a webhook URL.
errors.notEditable: That message wasn't sent by me or one of my webhooks.
errors.notComponentsV2: That message doesn't use Components V2 - edit it with the Embed Builder instead.
errors.manageGuildRequired: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
errors.attachmentMedia: This design uses an uploaded image as a thumbnail. Replace it with an image link, then import it again.
